resolution.note: krn-ctx-proxy disabled --now after the last proxy client (stale lead pane w1D:pJH) closed; unit file removed from ~/.config/systemd/user, daemon-reload, .krn/runs/ctx-proxy deleted. Proof: systemctl --user is-active krn-ctx-proxy = inactive; ss -ltn shows nothing on 47318.

title: The host ctx-proxy unit is stopped and removed
body:
Why: #616 (t-y11kzqf) removes the ctx-proxy code, but the host unit krn-ctx-proxy.service still runs from the main checkout and the predecessor lead session routed through it (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 127.0.0.1:47318), so it could not stop the unit itself.
Outcome: after #616 merges and no live session uses ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=127.0.0.1:47318, `systemctl --user disable --now krn-ctx-proxy`, the unit file under ~/.config/systemd/user is removed, and .krn/runs/ctx-proxy/ is deleted.
Proof: systemctl --user is-active krn-ctx-proxy prints inactive; ss -ltn shows nothing on 47318.
